build_MultiInstanceRoIHead: build a MultiInstanceRoIHead model with a specified number of instances for multi-instance prediction
init_bbox_head: initialize the bbox head and roi extractor using config dictionaries for the MultiInstanceRoIHead
review__bbox_forward: review the _bbox_forward method that extracts RoI features and returns classification scores and bbox predictions
test_bbox_loss: test the bbox_loss method to compute classification and bounding box regression losses with optional refine
run_loss: run the loss method to perform forward propagation and calculate detection ROI losses on upstream features
predict_bbox: predict bounding boxes and classification scores from region proposals using the bbox head forward pass
refactor_MultiInstanceRoIHead: refactor the MultiInstanceRoIHead class to support a different number of instances for prediction
